outstanding_findings.title: Matching source bytes and proposition text do not establish the same elaborated proposition/context

subcases.observation: The reduction target is the contract root_declaration string. check_task checks the canonical root file digest but collects/imports only the submitted solution module. It does not require the canonical root module in the checked environment.
subcases.consequence: A different submitted module can supply the same qualified declaration name while the unchanged canonical root file is unimported. A true checked implication in that environment need not be an implication to the pinned root. This finding concerns knowledge/relevance admission, not a demonstrated bypass of the separate exact-root completion gate.

subcases.observation: Generated attachment/representation/fiber types and terms reference MathGKM.ResearchSemantics names, but the checked wrapper imports only the proposer-selected module. The schema asks for importing ResearchSemantics; the validator does not independently force that actual canonical module/context.
subcases.consequence: Spelling the generic names is not authentication of the intended definitions and laws. Section/iff expressions provide substantive constraints, but the canonical fiber construction and its interpretation must still be bound.

subcases.observation: A newly accepted mathematical_claim closes any remaining obligation whose statement string equals item.statement. Its original elaborated declaration/context is not compared or transported.
subcases.consequence: An original module may interpret P differently from a later module, with all old sources still unchanged. Proving later P does not discharge original P merely because their strings coincide. Root-connected witness accounting inherits this ambiguity.

subcases.observation: Both sides reuse task JSON and root digest, but each adapter supplies its import module. No independently elaborated task context is bound on both sides. Explicit bounded_non_solution is accepted after source-hash checks without elaborating the task.
subcases.consequence: The two sides can assign a different meaning to a named predicate or the before side can lack a named task entirely. Honest non-solution status alone does not prove that both attempts addressed the same well-formed mathematical obligation.

outstanding_findings.required_acceptance_condition: Bind the actual declaration/import context and elaborated proposition to the canonical contract/foundations and original residual; check later discharge there or through a checked transport. Elaborate the fixed holdout in its common context independently of adapters, including an unsuccessful side. Preserve legitimate direct old proofs and genuine bounded non-solutions.

outstanding_findings.title: The paired after-transfer path does not enforce the declared required_constants list
outstanding_findings.observation: knowledge.ingest supplies required=item.required_constants to the inspector. evaluate_pair does not supply required, so it defaults to (). After eligibility is satisfied by any actually new frozen declaration. component_use_checked is merely a nonempty intersection and is not the acceptance condition.
outstanding_findings.consequence: A pair can receive transfer credit using a different new declaration while omitting explicitly required component constants. This is separate from the desirable ability of the before solver to prove the task without the new component.
outstanding_findings.required_acceptance_condition: Define the after-side required-component semantics and enforce it against the actual closure when transfer is claimed; do not force the before solver to use future components. Add an omitted-required-component negative case.

outstanding_findings.title: The formal whole-continuation specification is not connected to its instruction semantics or the Python implementation
outstanding_findings.observation: The final step now interprets Program.code and can install future programs. WholeSemantics.continue is constrained only at time 0. ImplementationBinding.simulates relates hostStep to step; its sem parameter is unused. No law connects continue to run/step. Byte/cost/environment fields are strings. No concrete binding instance or whole-switch proof is supplied.
outstanding_findings.consequence: Even a future inhabitant of the current binding record would not establish that the traces compared by WholeSwitch are the modeled executions. The actual Protocol guard and hash-bound host-event records have narrower meanings; they do not establish the Python/OS/LLM refinement or a certified scientific strategy improvement.
